workspace_intro: Tick the repositories Cleared works on.
workspace_none: Your token reaches no repository yet.
workspace_tick_hint: Only what is ticked is kept.
workspace_layout_manifests: {repo} has folders with a project of their own
workspace_layout_whole: The whole repository as one service
workspace_contracts_none: No contract file under a known name, such as contract/openapi.yaml.
workspace_links_none: No call between these services was found.
workspace_links_note: A call is read from the other service's contract: tick its contract line if it has one, or add the link later.
workspace_problem_no_forge: Connect your code first: the list comes from your token.
workspace_problem_unreachable: The list could not be read. Check the network and the token, then try again.
workspace_environment: The repositories come from Cleared's settings. Change them there.
workspace_error_invalid: The request was not understood. Reload the page and pick again.
workspace_error_too_many: Pick 10 repositories at most at a time.
workspace_error_unknown_repository: A picked repository is no longer on your token's list. Reload the page.
workspace_error_changed: The proposal changed since this page read it. Clone and propose again.
workspace_error_cycle: The ticked calls go round in a circle. Untick one of them, so that the services can be released in order.
workspace_error_invalid_workspace: Cleared could not read this choice. Its log says why.
workspace_error_environment: The repositories come from Cleared's settings: change them there.
workspace_error_busy: A clone is already running. Wait for it to end.
workspace_error_checkout_other: A folder on this machine already holds another repository. The log names it.
workspace_error_unreachable: The forge did not answer. Try again in a moment.
workspace_error_clone_failed: A repository could not be read. The log says why.
workspace_error_other: The step could not go on. Try again in a moment.
